name: comment-hunter
description: Search-driven viral-tweet hunter. Polls twitterapi.io advanced search for recent tweets matching topic queries, scores each by velocity vs the author's own baseline, and pings Telegram with a Claude-generated suggested reply. Notify-only — user opens X manually to post (avoids automated-reply shadowban patterns).

searchQueries: ("building in public" OR buildinpublic OR "shipped today") -airdrop -giveaway -$
("React Native" OR "Expo Go" OR "Expo SDK" OR "Expo Router" OR "mobile dev") -airdrop -token -$
